notes.title: The latest patch!
OWM News
notes.content:
The latest patch for the game will be released this spring.
The following will be added:
- car failure due to breakdown of spare parts
- youth academy instead of building “Mechanics”.
- possibility to customize the point system (it will be useful for historical mods)
- car upgrades will become paid and will cost quite impressive amounts.


Open Wheel Manager 2 is at the pre-production stage. We created a page on Patreon, where you can support the development, follow the progress of work and try the early builds of the game as soon as they are ready. 
Great to see you among our followers: https://www.patreon.com/paprikashworks

notes.title: Update to v.1.2.2
v.1.2.1 BETA
notes.content:
[b]UPDATE NOTES:[/b]
[list]
[*]reduced level of sponsors money
[*]changed upgrade balance - each iteration needs less points, the chance of purple iteration depends on upgrade size (numbers of iterations) and chief designer skills
[*]added upgrade focus: perfomance / reliability / no focus
[*]added screen with PC teams upgrades
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34901253/510ed5808656941df841c52534abe6c590feae58.jpg[/img]
[*]increased engine regress in off-season
[*]reduced team reputation growth in off-season
[*]teams budget reduced twice (for new game start)
[*]reduced prize payments by season results.

[b]FIXED BUGS:[/b]
[*]added mods validation check to select mod screen. It will fix game crashes if in the game folder are old format mods.
[*]retired drivers don't generate news about their plans to retire every season anymore.
[/list]

notes.title: BETA v.1.2
notes.content:
Great to invite you to take part in the OWM v1.2 beta testing.

We managed to realize all the features we wanted to include in this patch. However, there are the lack of help information in the interface and some flaws in the graphic part, and it don't allows us fully release this version.
To take part in the beta test, go to your library on Steam, right-click on OWM, select Properties and switch on the Beta branch as shown in the screenshot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34901253/73c2781004129efc08013b70997c1dd4a528ddb0.png[/img]

[h1]v.1.2 release notes:[/h1]
* removed next sections: Projects, Production and Carsetup;
* added new section Production;
* added the screen of contracts for next season of all teams (appears when some team sign the contract)
* fixed bug with driver roles that crashed the game in off-season or in first test session of new season.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34901253/940c02288cbc89ed448c81345274c3e7190909c3.png[/img]

[h1]New section Production:[/h1]
Each team have a standard set of 10 element instead of development, construction and installation of spare parts now. This abstract parts that are considered uniform on both teams cars. Wear and repair will be processed, and disabled yet. Parts upgrade is done in a package now, not in queue. All staff in the design and production departments are automatically involved in the upgrade.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34901253/d0339ea063f113d2f2ad7a057e8debb487416be5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34901253/0a3cde17e6369e0eae8b1c9caa94ead6127bf1ec.png[/img]

v.1.2 is compatible with old saves.

Please, be sure to report all bugs found to our communication channels.

notes.title: Our plans
notes.content:
There are 2updates for current version of the game in plans.
1. Big update of car development screen. The car will develop by update packs, not by single parts. This will decrease micromanagement and make every upgrade more.
It will looks like this:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34901253/d5db5998e9473cdde1a6371f54c960b55b0c263e.png[/img]

2. Statistics, youth championships results, race academy.

We are also planning decrease messeges about new contracts in news and make information about rival line-up for next season more visual.

The anouncement of Open Wheel Manager 2 is planed on the middle of Octobre.

notes.title: Version 0.8.7. What's new?
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34901253/c769299e4f1e32d0f9348d07b4248a3f2e1b0ca6.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] Hotkeys added.
[i]In "office": Space is Continue button; 
In race-screen: Space is Pause, 1,2,3 buttons - race speed switching[/i]
[*] Key staff can finish the career now
[*] 3 new young drivers are generated in every off- season.
[*] The new key staff will generated only if current one is not enough for all teams.
[*] Pay drivers added now. The chance to be a "pay driver"  for new young drivers is 30%, for current drivers is 10% on start of new game (only for non-top drivers).
[*] A new hidden parameter for drivers is talent. The talent is influence on skill improvement speed. If there no talent parameter in the game database in the drivers table, it will generated automatically
[/list]
